chapterInfo.content:
32
Wɔma Aaron yɛ sika nantwie ba
(Deuteronomium 9.6-29)
1 # Deut 9.8-21 Na ɔman no hunuu sɛ Mose akyɛreɛ na ɔnsiane mfiri bepɔ no so mma no, ɔman no boaa wɔn ano baa Aaron nkyɛn bɛsee no sɛ: Sɔre yɛ anyame ma yɛn, na wɔnni yɛn anim, ɛfiri sɛ Mose yi, ɔbarima a ɔkɔyii yɛn firii Misraim baeɛ no deɛ, yɛnnim deɛ ayɛ no. 2Ɛnna Aaron ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyiyi sika nkaa a ɛwowɔ mo yerenom ne mo mmabanin ne mo mmammaa aso mu mfa mmrɛ me. 3Na ɔman no nyinaa yiyii sika nkaa a ɛwowɔ wɔn aso mu no de brɛɛ Aaron. 4#Dwom 106.19-20; 1 Ah 12.28; Aso 7.41 Na ɔgyee wɔ wɔn nsam, na ɔde pɛeɛ yeyɛe, na ɔyɛɛ no nantwie a wɔaguo; na wɔkaa sɛ: Israel, yeinom ne w’anyame a wɔyii wo firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no. 5Na Aaron hunuu sɛ wɔn ani gye ho no, ɔsii afɔrebukyia wɔ n’anim; na ɔpaee sɛ: Ɔkyena ne AWURADE afahyɛ. 6#1 Ko 10.7 Na wɔtuaa nhema bobɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ; na ɔman no tenaa ase didii nomee, na wɔsɔre goroe.
7Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Siane kɔ, na wo man a wode wɔn firi Misraim asase so baeɛ no redi asɛmmɔne; 8#Eks 20.4, 23; 32.4 wɔamane afiri kwan a mekyerɛɛ wɔn no so ntɛm; wɔayɛ nantwie ba a wɔaguo, na wɔasɔre no abɔ afɔdeɛ ama no aka sɛ: Israel, yeinom ne w’anyame a wɔyii wo firii Misraim asase so baeɛ no. 9Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Mahunu ɔman yi, na hwɛ, wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔn kɔn asene; 10#Num 14.11-20 na afei ma me kwan na me bo nhuru ntia wɔn, na memmene wɔn, na memfa wo menyɛ ɔman kɛseɛ.
11Na Mose paa AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn kyɛw sɛ: AWURADE, adɛn nti na wo bo huru tia ɔman a wode ahoɔden kɛseɛ ne nsa a ɛyɛ den kɔyii wɔn Misraim asase so baeɛ no? 12Adɛn nti na Misraimfoɔ nka sɛ: Adwemmɔne bi nti na ɔbɛyii wɔn kɔeɛ sɛ ɔrekɔkum wɔn mmepɔ soɔ na wapra wɔn afiri asase ani? Sane firi w’abufuhyeɛ no mu, na ma bɔne a worebɛyɛ wo man no nyɛ wo ya. 13#Gye 22.16; 26.4; 28.14 Kae Abraham, Isak ne Israel, wo nkoa a wokaa wɔn wo ara wo ntam see wɔn sɛ: Mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma, na asase a maka ho asɛm yi nyinaa, mede bɛma w’asefoɔ na wɔadi so akɔsi daa no. 14Na AWURADE nuu ne ho wɔ bɔne a ɔkaa sɛ ɔrebɛyɛ ne man no ho.
15Na Mose danee ne ho siane firii bepɔ no so, na adanseɛ apono mmienu no kura ne nsam, aboɔpono a wɔatwerɛ n’afanu, wɔatwerɛ so ɛha ne ha. 16#Eks 31.18 Na apono no yɛ Nyankopɔn adwuma, na atwerɛ no yɛ Nyankopɔn atwerɛ a wɔakurukyire no apono no soɔ. 17Na Yosua tee sɛ ɔman no rebɔ ose na wɔreyɛ gyegyeegye no, ɔka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ɔko gyegyeegye wɔ nsraban no mu. 18Na ɔse: Ɛnyɛ nkonimdie ho sebɔ gyegyeegye na ɛnyɛ nkoguo ho nteamu gyegyeegye, na mmom ɛdwontoɔ gyegyeegye na meteɛ yi.
19Na ɛbaa sɛ Mose bɛn nsraban no na ɔhunuu nantwie ba ne asa no ara pɛ, ne bo fui, na ɔtoo apono a ɛwɔ ne nsam no gui maa no bobɔe wɔ bepɔ no ase.
20Na ɔfaa nantwie ba a wɔyɛeɛ no de gya hyee, na ɔyam no muhumuhu de petee nsuo ani maa Israelfoɔ no nomee. 21Na Mose bisaa Aaron sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ɔman yi yɛɛ woɔ a wode bɔne kɛseɛ aba wɔn soɔ yi?
22Ɛnna Aaron buaa sɛ: Mma me wura bo mmfu, wo ara wonim ɔman yi sɛ bɔne ara na wɔde asi wɔn anim. 23Na wɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Yɛ anyame ma yɛn na wɔnni yɛn anim, ɛfiri sɛ Mose yi, ɔbarima a ɔkɔyii yɛn firi Misraim asase so baeɛ no, yɛnnim deɛ ayɛ no. 24Na mesee wɔn sɛ: Wɔn a wɔwɔ sika bie no, wɔnyi. Na wɔde maa me, na meto guu gya mu, na nantwie ba yi firi mu bae.
25Na Mose hunuu sɛ ɔman no agye nsam no (Aaron na ama ɔman no nneyɛɛ agye nsam ama wɔabɔ wɔn ho adapaa, w’atamfo anim no), 26ɔgyinaa nsraban no tia kaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔwɔ AWURADE afa mmra me nkyɛn. Na Lewifoɔ nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ano baa ne nkyɛn. 27Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Momfa mo nkrantɛ mmobɔ mo asene, na montwa nkɔ, na monsane mmra, mfiri nsraban no tia nkɔ tia, na monkunkum mo nuanom ne mo nnamfonom ne mo afipamfoɔ. 28Na Lewifoɔ no yɛɛ sɛdeɛ Mose ka kyerɛɛ wɔn no, na ɛda no ɔman no mu nnipa bɛyɛ mpensa totɔe. 29#Eks 28.41; Num 3.6-10; Deut 33.8-11 Na Mose kaa sɛ: Moayɛ mo ho kronkron ama AWURADE nnɛ, sɛ obiara bɛsɔre atia ne ba ne ne nua mpo, na mode nhyira aba mo so nnɛ.
30Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Mose ka kyerɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Mo deɛ, moayɛ bɔne kɛse, na afei mɛforo makɔ AWURADE nkyɛn, ebia mɛtumi mapata ama mo bɔne no. 31Na Mose sane kɔɔ AWURADE nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: Ao, bɔne kɛseɛ na ɔman yi ayɛ, na wɔayɛ sika anyame afa. 32#Dwom 69.28; Dan 12.1; Luk 10.20; Rom 9.3 Na afei, sɛ wode wɔn bɔne no bɛkyɛ a! Na sɛ ɛnte saa a, pepa me nso firi wo nwoma a woatwerɛ no mu ɛ! 33Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Deɛ wayɛ me bɔne no, ɔno na mɛpepa no mafiri me nwoma mu. 34#Eks 33.2, 12, 14 Na afei kɔ, na kɔgya ɔman no kɔ deɛ maka makyerɛ woɔ no; hwɛ, me bɔfoɔ bɛdi w’anim; nanso da a mɛba abɛhwɛ wɔn no, mɛtua wɔn wɔn bɔne so ka. 35Na sɛ wɔayɛ nantwie ba a Aaron yɛeɛ no nti, AWURADE haa ɔman no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
